checks: Actual HTML webview loads CSS, JS and JSON and refreshes after a file save
Native editing saves through the file channel; complete folder upload uses real OpenSSH SFTP
Repeated HTML and Markdown previews keep independent permanent tabs without creating a split
privacy: Disposable profile, synthetic host aliases and project documents, isolated tmux sockets, actual Python file channel and OpenSSH SFTP. Agent icons are display-only; no model or private conversation is used.
transport: Local SSH shim executes the same remote commands against an isolated local fixture; SFTP runs the real OpenSSH server.
